text: 证监会主席吴清在参加2026中国资本市场学术年会时表示，进一步深化市场微观结构研究。为进一步提升市场定价和发展质量，需要深入研究改善资本供给结构，加快发展壮大长期资本、耐心资本；深入研究改善预期引导机制，减少“羊群效应”“短期化”交易带来的市场波动；还要深入研究评估量化交易、股份减持等制度规则的优化和公平合理的监管安排，切实保护好投资者合法权益。
text_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that research on market microstructure should be further deepened. To further improve market pricing and development quality, it is necessary to conduct in-depth research on improving the capital supply structure and accelerate the development and expansion of long-term capital and patient capital; conduct in-depth research on improving expectation-guidance mechanisms and reduce market volatility caused by the "herd effect" and "short-term" trading; and also conduct in-depth research and evaluation of the optimization of institutional rules such as quantitative trading and share reductions and of fair and reasonable regulatory arrangements, so as to effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors.
